name: Score segmentation against experts
summary: Compares automatic masks with expert masks of the same cases, structure by structure: Dice, volumes and their difference, and a mean per group.
help: Wire the Segmented cases of Segment CT automatically into Automatic, and the dataset with expert labels (<case>/segmentations/<structure>.nii.gz) into Experts. Cases and structures are matched by name; structures only one side has are listed with Dice 0.

outputs.label: Score per structure
outputs.help: score.csv: case, structure, group, dice, expert_ml, auto_ml, volume_diff_pct, note

outputs.label: Summary
outputs.help: summary.json: mean and median Dice, overall and per group

params.label: Smallest (ml)
params.help: Structures smaller than this on both sides are left out (slivers at the scan's edges)
